data.action: 坐在天台长椅上咬着筷子凝望天空
data.description: 【后藤一里 · 天台午休时光】空旷安静的教学楼天台铁丝网旁，微风拂过蔚蓝天际。后藤一里坐在长椅上打开便当盒，微风掀动水手服的领巾，她咬着筷子望向远方的积雨云，享受着无拘无束的片刻独处——「不用看别人脸色的天台……是世界上最棒的秘密宝座。」
data.lighting: 明媚正午天光与开阔天际反光
data.promptProse: Hitori sits on a rooftop bench beside the wire fence, opening her bento and briefly holding the chopsticks between her lips while looking toward distant towering clouds. Her summer sailor uniform and red ribbon stir in the breeze. The low medium view includes the lunch box forward and wide sky behind. Noon daylight illuminates the rice and white collar, with soft open-sky reflections easing the shade beneath her hands.
data.title: 后藤一里 · 天台午休时光
